therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: neuroprotective agent preventing oxaliplatin-induced peripheral neuropathy
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with metastatic colorectal cancer receiving oxaliplatin-based chemotherapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: clinical evaluation of peripheral sensory neuropathy using oxaliplatin specific scale

modulation_entries.hypothesis: xaliproden prevents oxaliplatin-induced peripheral neuropathy through 5-HT1A receptor-mediated neuroprotection
modulation_entries.citation: Evaluation of the Efficacy of Xaliproden (SR57746A) in Preventing the Neurotoxicity of Oxaliplatin
